about: Ask AccordAI golden set (30 questions, KNT books). `tool` is the expected first tool (the fallback router must pick it; a model run is scored against it too). `refuse` questions must be refused with that code before any tool or model call. Used by tests/unit/assistant/test_assistant_golden.py and for Jonathan's live benchmark (docs/api/assistant.md).
